$description: Devis, Day: the base and the look, as the CSS declares them. Generated by scripts/build.mjs.

space-1.$description: Icon to label, avatar overlap step.

space-3.$description: Row padding, field label to input.

space-6.$description: Desktop gutter, between sections in a panel.

space-14.$description: Above page titles on wide screens.

radius-s.$description: Kbd boxes, link chips, thumbnails in rows.

border-object.$description: Outline of every card, input, button and pill.

border-field.$description: Width of a text input's edge.

duration-pop.$description: Things you caused appearing: ticks, chips, popovers.

duration-glide.$description: Panels and drawers sliding, list items moving.

duration-drift.$description: Things arriving on their own: presence, live updates, page transitions.

duration-pen.$description: Lines that draw themselves: ticks, underlines, rings, the seal.

ease-spring.$description: Snap and pop: a small overshoot. Motion spring: stiffness 400, damping 22.

ease-pen.$description: Lines that draw themselves: ticks, underlines, rings, the seal.

font-display.$description: Display type: page and entry titles, headings.

font-mono.$description: Code, ids, keys and keyboard hints.

font-celebrate.$description: Celebrations only; at most once per session.

font-money.$description: Devis only: quote titles and money totals. Write `font-family: var(--font-money, var(--font-display))` so other looks keep their display face.

text-display.$description: The one big line on a screen: a greeting, a poster number. A whole font value: write `font: var(--text-display)`, with `letter-spacing: var(--text-display-tracking)`.

text-page-title.$description: Page and entry titles. A whole font value: write `font: var(--text-page-title)`, with `letter-spacing: var(--text-page-title-tracking)`.

text-title.$description: Panel and dialog titles. A whole font value: write `font: var(--text-title)`, with `letter-spacing: var(--text-title-tracking)`.

text-section.$description: Card, tile and form-section headings. A whole font value: write `font: var(--text-section)`, with `letter-spacing: var(--text-section-tracking)`.

text-item.$description: Names in rows and on cards. A whole font value: write `font: var(--text-item)`, with `letter-spacing: var(--text-item-tracking)`.

text-voice.$description: The app speaking: a gentle note, an empty translation. A whole font value: write `font: var(--text-voice)`, with `letter-spacing: var(--text-voice-tracking)`.

text-body-l.$description: Rich text and previews. A whole font value: write `font: var(--text-body-l)`, with `letter-spacing: var(--text-body-l-tracking)`.

text-body.$description: Default UI text and inputs. A whole font value: write `font: var(--text-body)`, with `letter-spacing: var(--text-body-tracking)`.

text-body-strong.$description: Names and button labels. A whole font value: write `font: var(--text-body-strong)`, with `letter-spacing: var(--text-body-strong-tracking)`.

text-small.$description: Metadata, help text, table cells. A whole font value: write `font: var(--text-small)`, with `letter-spacing: var(--text-small-tracking)`.

text-label.$description: Eyebrows and section labels (with --label-case). A whole font value: write `font: var(--text-label)`, with `letter-spacing: var(--text-label-tracking)`.

text-code.$description: Endpoints, JSON, ids, keys. A whole font value: write `font: var(--text-code)`, with `letter-spacing: var(--text-code-tracking)`.

text-kbd.$description: Keyboard hints. A whole font value: write `font: var(--text-kbd)`, with `letter-spacing: var(--text-kbd-tracking)`.

text-celebrate.$description: Celebrations only; at most once per session. A whole font value: write `font: var(--text-celebrate)`, with `letter-spacing: var(--text-celebrate-tracking)`.

text-empty.$description: Empty states: one line. A whole font value: write `font: var(--text-empty)`, with `letter-spacing: var(--text-empty-tracking)`.

shadow-highlight.$description: A preview or field that just changed (new structure preview, toast).

outline.$description: The edge of objects: cards, tables, panels.

outline-control.$description: The edge of controls: buttons, switches, checkboxes.

outline-field.$description: The edge of a text input at rest.

outline-field-active.$description: The edge of a text input, hovered or focused.

focus-edge.$description: The focus ring's inner edge, drawn under the outline with `box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--focus-edge)`. Transparent in Folio.

mark.$description: Highlighted text: mark in rich text, search hits. Pair with --on-mark.

inverse.$description: Toasts, tooltips and the offline banner: the one dark-on-light (or light-on-dark) object. Discothèque role: chocolate.

on-inverse-accent.$description: The action word in a toast (Undo, View): ≥5:1 on inverse in both themes.

on-chocolate-accent.$description: An accent on the top bar and sidebar.

paper.$description: Page ground behind everything. The Studio never sits on white.

paper-raised.$description: Cards, tiles, inputs' surroundings, dialogs: anything that is an object on the page.

paper-sunk.$description: Board columns, progress tracks, wells, skeleton base.

paper-tint.$description: Hover on rows and tiles; empty translation cells; dashed drop zones.

field.$description: Inside text inputs and editors only, so typing surfaces read as paper you write on.

ink.$description: Primary text and the 2px outline of every object (cards, dialogs, tables, buttons). 12:1 on paper.

ink-muted.$description: Secondary text, metadata, labels. ≥6:1 on paper and paper-raised in both themes.

ink-subtle.$description: Placeholders, drag grips, disabled text. Still ≥5:1; never for the only copy of an instruction.

rule.$description: Dotted dividers between rows and fields (2px dotted). Decorative only.

ink-line.$description: The 1.5px edge of text inputs, search boxes and editors; ink on hover and focus. Objects keep ink. ≥3:1 on field, paper and paper-sunk in both themes.

chocolate.$description: Top bar, command palette shadow, toasts, the offline banner. Code wells have --code.

chocolate-soft.$description: Sidebar ground; inputs inside the top bar.

on-chocolate-muted.$description: Secondary text in the top bar and sidebar.

code.$description: Code wells: blocks of code, terminals, requests and answers. Dark in both themes, so code reads the same everywhere.

on-code.$description: Code and plain text in a code well.

on-code-muted.$description: Comments, punctuation, line numbers and labels in a code well.

code-rule.$description: Lines between rows and panes inside a code well. Decorative only.

code-keyword.$description: Keywords, keys and the line being pointed at in a code well.

code-string.$description: Strings and values in a code well.

code-function.$description: Function names, numbers and constants in a code well.

code-focus.$description: The focus ring on controls inside a code well (draw it without --focus-edge there).

mustard.$description: The signature fill, for small things: the selected item, counts, review state, highlights. Always with ink text (6.7:1). A big 'needs you' panel takes panel-highlight.

on-mustard.$description: Text on mustard in both themes (6.7:1).

mustard-soft.$description: Inserted text in diffs, freshly added rows, warning suggestions.

panel-highlight.$description: A big panel that calls for you ('needs you', getting started): mustard in Lights on, mustard-soft in Lights off, where a wall of mustard glares. Pair with on-panel-highlight and shadow-panel-highlight. Selections, counts and small highlights stay mustard.

on-panel-highlight.$description: Text on panel-highlight: on-mustard in Lights on (6.7:1), ink in Lights off.

orange.$description: Decorative fills and display italics ≥28px, stripes, cursors. NOT for small text or white-on-orange buttons (3.7:1).

action.$description: Primary buttons (Publish, Save, New). Pair with on-action.

rust.$description: Danger and errors: text on paper (5.2:1), deletions in diffs, stamps, links.

rust-soft.$description: Background of blocking problems and deleted text.

avocado.$description: Large fills for 'live' and success areas (tiles, stubs). Text on it: on-avocado, and only large (18.5px bold or 24px).

on-avocado.$description: Large text on avocado: ink in Lights on (3.8:1), Lights-off paper in Lights off (7.7:1), where cream ink would be 2.0:1.

success.$description: Live status pill and success buttons. White text on it in light (6.4:1), paper text in dark.

success-soft.$description: Background of live pills and 'all caught up' notices.

warning-ink.$description: Warning text on paper (5.2:1): suggestions, counters near their limit.

teal.$description: Scheduled and informational: 'goes out Nov 13', scheduled pills, info notes.

plum.$description: Sixth presence colour; never a status.

focus.$description: 3px focus ring offset 2px, on every interactive element, with --focus-edge filling the gap inside it: mustard alone is 1.8:1 on Lights-on paper.

on-plum.$description: Text on plum and teal fills (presence tabs, type squares).

stripe-band.$description: Height of each of the four rainbow stripes under the top bar.

press.$description: How far a primary button travels into its shadow when pressed.

lift.$description: How far a hovered object rises.

gutter.$description: The page's side margin: --space-4 on phones, --space-6 from the medium breakpoint.

region-gap.$description: The gap between a page's major regions.
